title: FAA to roll out text IFR departure clearances for general aviation pilots in early 2027
summary: The FAA's Mobile Clearance, which sends IFR departure clearances to general-aviation pilots' flight-planning apps as text, is being evaluated at eleven US airports and is planned for deployment in early 2027.
